description: Checks the named entities in an AI answer (up to 5 capitalised names) against Wikidata: each name is marked found or not found, with its Wikidata ID and description, and sentences containing a year are listed for review. It checks that entities exist, not that claims about them are true, so a found entity can still have a wrong fact. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

text.description: The model answer to check, 10 to 5000 characters
